n: In September 1830, Hiram Page claimed revelations through a seer stone, and some members, including Oliver, believed him. The Lord tells Oliver that the Church will listen to him when he teaches by the Holy Ghost.
A crucial principle of Church order: only Joseph is appointed to receive commandments and revelations for the whole Church, as Moses did for Israel.

f.w: no one shall be appointed to receive commandments and revelations in this church

n: Oliver should support Joseph as Aaron supported Moses — faithfully declaring the revelations with authority.
Oliver may speak or teach by inspiration whenever the Spirit leads.
But he should not write as though giving commandments to the Church — only wise counsel.
Nor should Oliver command Joseph, who presides over him and the Church.
Joseph holds the keys of revelation until the Lord appoints a successor.

f.w: until I shall appoint unto them another in his stead

n: Oliver is called on a mission to the Lamanites (Native Americans) to establish the Church among them. He may receive revelations, but not as commandments for the Church.
No one yet knows where the city of Zion will be built, but it will be near the Lamanite borders. In 1831 it was revealed to be Independence, Missouri.
Oliver should stay for the conference, where Joseph will be sustained to preside, and then relay what Joseph tells him.
Oliver is to speak privately with Hiram Page and tell him his stone revelations are not from God but from Satan. Private correction preserves dignity.

f.g: brother-in-law of the Whitmers and one of the Eight Witnesses.

n: Such revelations were never assigned to Hiram, and nothing contrary to the Church covenants will be.
Everything must be done in order and by common consent, through faithful prayer.

f.w: all things must be done in order

n: Oliver should help resolve this matter according to Church covenants before leaving on his mission.
The Lord will guide Oliver from departure to return.
He should declare the gospel always, with joy.

f.w: open thy mouth at all times
